DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors;

CREATE TABLE tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors
(
 Provider   VARCHAR(150) NULL,
 SiteName   VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 RackName   VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 RackNumber   VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 Temperature   VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 Humidity   VARCHAR(255) NULL,
 SensorTimestamp  DATETIME NULL,
 FileName   VARCHAR(255) NULL
) ON [PRIMARY];

--Transform data and append into main and backup tables

--1 (Populate Provider field)
UPDATE tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors
SET [Provider] = 'Databank';


--2 (Add site names to simplify downstream logic throughout the SPM process)
UPDATE sn
SET SiteName = CASE sn.RackName
 WHEN 'DEN2' THEN 'NCR Denver Centennial'
 WHEN 'DEN3' THEN 'NCR Denver'
 WHEN 'DFW5' THEN 'NCR Dallas'
 ELSE NULL
END
FROM tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors AS sn;


--3 (Transform/Convert invalid data to NULL in the two fields | e.g. Value of 'null' converted to NULL)
--Reimagine | Gen2 | NextGen: Source CSV data contains 'null' values so this logic will allow data to load properly & the SSIS Package will not fail
--UPDATE tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors SET Temperature = TRY_CAST(Temperature AS FLOAT), Humidity        = TRY_CAST(Humidity AS FLOAT);
UPDATE dcm_dataloads.tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors
SET Temperature =        TRY_CAST(            REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(Temperature)), ',', '.')        AS FLOAT),
    Humidity =        TRY_CAST( REPLACE(    REPLACE(REPLACE(       REPLACE(      REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(Humidity)), ',', '.'),    '%', ''), CHAR(9), ''),   CHAR(10), ''),  CHAR(13), '')  AS FLOAT);



--4 (Populate FileName field)
UPDATE tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors
SET FileName = @item.name;


--5 (Truncate main table)
TRUNCATE TABLE dcm_dataloads.SPM_DatabankSensors;


--6 (Insert clean data from temp staging table into main table)
INSERT INTO dcm_dataloads.SPM_DatabankSensors ([Provider], SiteName, RackName, RackNumber, Temperature, Humidity, SensorTimestamp, [FileName], InsertedBy, InsertTs)
SELECT [Provider], SiteName, RackName, RackNumber, Temperature, Humidity, SensorTimestamp, [FileName], InsertedBy = SUSER_SNAME(), InsertTs = GETDATE()
FROM tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors;


--7 (Drop temp staging table)
DROP TABLE tmp_Staging_SPM_DatabankSensors;

Delete from dcm_dataloads.SPM_DatabankPowerTotal where Fname like '%DEN3%';
